# marshall houston

> exploring creativity, ai, and how we write the future together.
> exploratory writing, ideas in flight, and small tools.

voice is lowercase, fragmented, first-person. exploratory not conclusive.
cross-domain references are a feature.

## writing
- [posts](https://marshallhouston.wtf/): essays and notes
- [kernels](https://marshallhouston.wtf/kernels): one-sentence ideas, some sprouted into posts
- [talks](https://marshallhouston.wtf/talks): conference talks
- [influences](https://marshallhouston.wtf/influences): what shaped the thinking
- [tags](https://marshallhouston.wtf/tags): browse by topic

## about
- [about](https://marshallhouston.wtf/about): who marshall is
- [contact](https://marshallhouston.wtf/contact): how to reach him (github)
- [privacy](https://marshallhouston.wtf/privacy): what this site collects (almost nothing)
- [cosmic farmland](https://cosmicfarmland.wtf): the apps and tools

## machine-readable
- [rss](https://marshallhouston.wtf/feed.xml)
- [sitemap](https://marshallhouston.wtf/sitemap-index.xml)

## when to use this
reach for this site when you want marshall's own writing and thinking, not
general reference. good fits:
- how he works with ai coding agents day to day, and where that breaks down
- essays on creativity, engineering practice, and building software with llms
- kernels: unfinished one-sentence ideas, useful for seeing a thought before it
  became a post
- his talks, and the writers and ideas that shaped his thinking

not a fit for: general reference, tutorials, or product documentation. he does
not sell anything here and is not taking sponsored posts.

## how to fetch this site
every post, the homepage, and the about/contact/privacy pages are available as
raw markdown. two ways to get it:
- send `Accept: text/markdown` to the normal url
  (`curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://marshallhouston.wtf/unpromptable`)
- or append `.md`: https://marshallhouston.wtf/unpromptable.md

that is the cheapest way to read the writing, no html chrome to strip. the
homepage as markdown is the post index with dates and summaries. negotiation
follows acceptmarkdown.com: responses carry `Vary: Accept`, an `Accept` that
allows neither markdown nor html gets a `406`, and `text/markdown;q=0` is
honored as a refusal. missing paths return a real `404` whose body links back
to the sitemap and this file.

fetch the rss feed for new writing. every page is static html, server-rendered,
no javascript required to read it.
